text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Wednesday, February 6, 2019 Posted by admin on February 6th, 2019
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Boeing (BA), up +27.19% YTD. There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +17 points.
Tuesday the Dow was up +172.15 (+0.68%) at 25,411.52.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +8.93%.
There were 21 Dow stocks up Tuesday.
The Dow stock winners Tuesday were led by Boeing (BA) +3.32%, DowDuPont (DWDP) +2.13% and Apple (AAPL) +1.71%.
The Dow stock losers Monday were led by Pfizer (PFE) -0.78%, UnitedHealth (UNH) -0.71% and Procter & Gamble (PG) -0.60%.
The US Energy Information Administration will release a report on crude oil inventories at 10:30 a.m. ET. US crude futures dropped 0.9% to trade at $53.20 per barrel.
Markets in mainland China, Hong Kong and South Korea are closed for holidays.
European stocks are lower and Asian markets ended higher.
The national average price of gasoline is up 1.3 cents at $2.277 per gallon.
